newsitem.title: CHINA: FORECAST - China to put 125 bln yuan in circulation.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - China to put 125 bln yuan in circulation.

text.p: China expects to put 125 billion yuan of currency into circulation in 1997, economists from the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences and the State Statistics Bureau said in a report on Friday.
China's State Planning Commission said last month it planned to put 120 billion yuan of currency into circulation this year, a rise of 20 percent from the target for 1996.
China put an actual 91.7 billion yuan into circulation in 1996, up 11.6 percent from the previous year.
China also planned to extend 1.1 trillion yuan worth of new loans, said the report, excerpts of which were issued by the official Xinhua news agency.
